requirements.text: Greet a named user from the command line

criteria.text: node bin/hello.js Ada prints Hello, Ada! and exits 0
criteria.evidence: Static inference. bin/hello.js:4-5 sets shoutMode=false for argv[2]='Ada' and name='Ada'; bin/hello.js:11 calls console.log(greet('Ada')); src/greet.js:2 returns `Hello, ${name}!`; process.exitCode is never set on this path so exit is 0. Covered by tests/cli.test.js:8-15 which spawns the entry point with 'Ada' and asserts status 0, stdout 'Hello, Ada!\n', stderr ''.

criteria.text: node bin/hello.js --shout Ada prints HELLO, ADA! and exits 0
criteria.evidence: Static inference. bin/hello.js:4 sets shoutMode=true when argv[2]==='--shout', bin/hello.js:5 takes name from argv[3], bin/hello.js:11 prints shout(greet(name)); src/format.js:2 returns text.toUpperCase(), yielding 'HELLO, ADA!'. Matches D-002 composition. Covered by tests/cli.test.js:26-33 (status 0, stdout 'HELLO, ADA!\n') and tests/format.test.js:6-8.

criteria.text: running with no name exits 2 and prints a usage line to stderr
criteria.evidence: Static inference. With no args, bin/hello.js:5 yields name=undefined; bin/hello.js:7-9 writes 'Usage: node bin/hello.js <name>' via console.error (stderr) and sets process.exitCode=2; nothing is written to stdout. Covered by tests/cli.test.js:17-24 (status 2, stdout '', stderr usage line) and the additional case '--shout' with no name at tests/cli.test.js:35-42.

criteria.text: npm test passes with at least one test per functional requirement
criteria.evidence: Static inference, not an observed run. package.json:7 defines test as 'node --test --test-reporter=spec'; Node's default discovery matches **/*.test.js so tests/cli.test.js, tests/format.test.js, tests/greet.test.js are collected (D-003). Per-requirement coverage: FR-001 at tests/cli.test.js:8 and tests/greet.test.js:5; FR-002 at tests/cli.test.js:26 and tests/format.test.js:6; FR-003 at tests/cli.test.js:17 and :35. Every assertion was traced against the source and matches expected output exactly, including trailing newlines from console.log/console.error. No dependencies are required (package.json has none), so install state cannot cause failure.

decisions.title: Entry point
decisions.decision: bin/hello.js parses argv and owns exit codes; src/greet.js stays pure

decisions.title: Shout formatting
decisions.decision: src/format.js exports shout(text); the CLI composes shout(greet(name))

decisions.decision: node --test under tests/; the approved check is npm test
